claims.title: Magnetic shear pushforwards, averaged diffusion and coupled MHD interfaces

quoted_fields.interface: On unit T3,kappa=2pi,F=e_i s(x_j),i!=j,s sine/cosine,c=sprime,E=e_i tensor e_j,Phi_a=x+a s e_i,T_a q=q(x-a s e_i),a=integral b. Magnetic fields are smooth divergence-free and mean zero for the exact identities,extended by the stated fixed-order Sobolev bounds. Actual MHD has viscosity nu>0,resistivity rho>0,velocity/magnetic disturbances f,h and projected Lorentz force. Magnetic M is not the Euler velocity propagator Q. Ideal helicity obstruction assumes rho0,closed torus,no direct magnetic forcing/disturbance and sufficient regularity.
quoted_fields.failure: Formal enhanced magnetic heat is not a physical finite controller. Both actual inviscid blocks must be reset and both moving-frame viscous/nonlinear errors controlled uniformly,without multiplying nonunitary bounds per sample. Local MHD estimates are not global regularity or simultaneous controllability. Ideal rho0 helicity does not establish a positive-resistivity impossibility. Nonzero mean magnetic field independently blocks a zero target on a torus. Liao-Sueur-Zhang2505.07366v1 concerns a bounded simply connected domain,control on the boundary of BOTH fields,Navier elsewhere,NONRESISTIVE equations and H24/H8 data; it does not transfer a mechanical-only periodic common-H1 polynomial theorem. Van Veen-Goto1512.02570v1 cubic Kolmogorov linear stability likewise does not prove generic carrier stability or a new MHD compiler. No source hold lifted.
